nodes.text:
@gavi Understanding evolutionary dynamics of viruses will protect ourselves in future.

Viral  evolution is a rapid and ruthless process .

Virus is a variable part of inexhaustibly creative evolution.

Pandemic is not a discrete, static or limited event,it is evolution in action.
